dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)><$comeff(1,3)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>, you’re awake!
<$voicel(1,6)>Did you sleep well?

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,23)><$comeff(1,10)>Today I plan to start searching for clues about what
happened to the humans.
<$voicel(1,9)>Meeting you has stirred up hope in this old heart!

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,666)>There’s a human-made building over yonder.
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,10)>It’s in a pretty sorry state...but that’s where I plan to begin
my investigation!

<$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,4)>If you don’t mind, I could use your help.
<$voicel(1,9)><$comeff(1,9)>We might find something useful.
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)>I’m very curious about that building.

<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,826)><$facial(1,9)><$comeff(1,7)>Oh dear... It looks so badly broken down... <$voicel(1,4)>I don’t even
know where to begin.

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,803)><$comeff(1,5)>Oho! Here’s something I recognize! It’s called a <$cdef(27)>PC!
<$voicel(1,5)>I haven’t the foggiest idea how to use it, but it always
seemed awfully handy!
<$emotion(1,13)><$voicel(1,4)>I wonder how this is used...
<$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,646)>Ya-yah!
<$emotion(1,15)>*beep beep beep*

Rebooting <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center management system...
Please use the <$cdef(27)>PC.

<$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,899)>Wha—? What’s this?! The <$cdef(27)>PC is talking! <$voicel(1,4)><$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$facial(1,10)>Did I make
it angry?!
<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,9)>Please, <$cdef(27)>! Figure out what the
<$cdef(27)>PC wants!

<$voicel(1,5)><$motion(1,661)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,9)>Please, <$cdef(27)>! Figure out what the
<$cdef(27)>PC wants!

<$facial(1,1)>*beep beep beep*
Please use the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center <$cdef(27)>PC.
Scanning surroundings...
Scan complete. Displaying results...

<$motion(1,899)><$facial(1,13)><$cdef(27)>Environment Level: Terrible
This environment is not suitable for Pokémon to live in.
<$voicel(1,1)><$facial(1,13)><$comeff(1,4)>What?! Oh dear... I DID make it angry, didn’t I?
<$facial(1,13)>Booting up <$cdef(27)>Poké Life</color>, the environment improvement app...

The <$cdef(27)>Poké Life app is committed to creating a comfortable
environment for Pokémon and humans!

By completing <$cdef(27)>challenges provided each day by <$cdef(27)>Poké Life,
you can gradually restore the environment to a state
where Pokémon can live comfortably!

We’ve prepared a few goals for you...
The first <$cdef(27)>challenges should be fairly easy, so please give
them a try!

And of course, those who complete <$cdef(27)>challenges will receive
some wonderful gifts!
Now go out and live your best <$cdef(27)>Poké Life!
<$voicel(1,4)>...Has it finally calmed down?

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,802)>I didn’t understand a whit of what that <$cdef(27)>PC was saying...
<$voicel(1,6)>But I hope it will be useful to YOU!

<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,801)>This <$cdef(27)>PC really does seem like it could be helpful!
<$voicel(1,9)>It’s probably a good idea to come check it every now
and again.
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,23)>I’ll keep investigating around here for a bit.
*deedle-beep!*
You’ve successfully completed a <$cdef(27)>challenge</color>!

You can report your completed <$cdef(27)>challenges at
<$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center PCs!

Congratulations on completing a <$cdef(27)>challenge!
You got some <$cdef(27)>Life Coins!

You can spend <$cdef(27)>Life Coins at the <$cdef(27)>shop! Try opening up the
<$cdef(27)>shop window right now!

You can exchange <$cdef(27)>Life Coins for various rewards at
this shop!
Use them to make life more comfortable for you and
for Pokémon!
Keep on living your best Poké Life!
<$voicel(1,9)><$emotion(1,15)>What’s this?! You can get human items from that <$cdef(27)>PC</color>?!

<$voicel(1,5)>I see. It looks like you can use the items you receive to
help other Pokémon.
<$voicel(1,7)><$motion(1,824)><$facial(1,4)>And my word—are you ever good at wrangling that <$cdef(27)>PC!
<$voicel(1,10)>I’m amazed you can use it so well!
<$voicel(1,3)><$motion(1,802)><$comeff(1,7)><$textsize(0)>Maybe I’ll give it a whirl myself, but it sure doesn’t look easy...</textsize>

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,1)>It was quite the surprise to learn you could get items
from a <$cdef(27)>PC.
<$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,7)><$comeff(1,10)>I’m sure those human items will come in handy!

Complete <$cdef(27)>challenges to earn <$cdef(27)>Life Coins, which you can
exchange for various items!

Congratulations! You’ve completed all of the
first <$cdef(27)>challenges!
And since you’re such a go-getter, here’s a special request!
Please raise the <$cdef(27)>comfort level</color> for one Pokémon living here!

You can improve a Pokémon’s <$cdef(27)>comfort level by adjusting
the environment so they feel happy and comfortable.

Different Pokémon prefer different environments, so try
out a variety of things to help!

If you successfully improve one Pokémon’s <$cdef(27)>comfort level,
you’ll unlock new <$cdef(27)>challenges!

So with that, please do your best to complete the
<$cdef(27)>comfort level challenge!

<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,14)>Oho, <$cdef(27)>, I see you’re using
the <$cdef(27)>PC!
<$voicel(1,8)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)>I knew I could leave that to you!

<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>Is it safe to assume you agree that this area still isn’t
exactly a pleasant place to live?
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,9)>If you could use that human-like dexterity of yours to
help improve the other Pokémon’s <$cdef(27)>comfort levels, <$voicel(1,7)>I’d be
very grateful!

<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Come to think of it, <$cdef(27)>Bulbasaur seems to have a
problem of some sort.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)>So why don’t you start by talking to <$cdef(27)>Bulbasaur?
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,827)><$voicel(1,8)>I’d like to help raise the Pokémon’s <$cdef(27)>comfort levels</color>.
<$motion(1,654)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Why don’t you start by asking <$cdef(27)>Bulbasaur </color>what they want?
*deedle-beep!*

Congratulations! You raised <$cdef(27)>Bulbasaur’s <$cdef(27)>comfort level!
There are new <$cdef(27)>challenges available at the nearest
<$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center <$cdef(27)>PC!

Thank you! The <$cdef(27)>environment level has risen!
You can raise the <$cdef(27)>environment level further by increasing
the number of Pokémon who live here and improving
their <$cdef(27)>comfort levels!
As the <$cdef(27)>environment level rises, new <$cdef(27)>challenges will be
unlocked, and you will also see a broader selection of
items available at the <$cdef(27)>shop!
Please keep up the good work, and keep on living your
best <$cdef(27)>Poké Life!

<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,5)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>, you’re awake!
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,1)>Nice to see you up. It’s a splendid morning!

<$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,5)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>, you’re awake!
<$voicel(1,5)><$emotion(1,1)>You certainly slept a good long while. It’s already getting
dark again.

<$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(1,5)>Oh, <$cdef(27)>, you’re awake!
<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,1)>Did you know you slept for an entire day? Hohoho!
<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,824)>Is there anything else you’d like to ask me about?<$motion(1,652)>

Try to complete some of the available <$cdef(27)>challenges!
You can check <$cdef(27)>challenge requirements and your progress
any time at the <$cdef(27)>PC.

<$voicel(1,7)><$emotion(1,14)>Oh, you’ve already revived some tall grass? Let’s wait a bit
and see what happens.

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>Ah, you’ve restored a <$cdef(27)><$hatname(3)> habitat!
<$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Now that that’s here, I’ve got a feeling some Pokémon
might show back up. <$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Let’s wait for a bit and see.

Seems like <$cdef(27)>Charmander is ready to follow you! Now head
on over to the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)>!

If you wait for a moment in front of the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)>,
<$cdef(27)>Charmander will light it for you.
<$voicel(4,8)><$emotion(4,49)>Take me to that <$cdef(27)><fqty(1)><$ifull(1280)></color>!

Head over to the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)> while <$cdef(27)>Charmander is
following you.

If you wait for a moment by the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)>,
<$cdef(27)>Charmander will light it for you.
Turn your body to face the <$cdef(27)><$ifull(1280)> so <$cdef(27)>Charmander
can find it, then wait.
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Hohoho, it looks like your <$cdef(27)>comfort level</color> work went well!

<$voicel(1,5)><$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,824)>As I suspected, when you want to raise a Pokémon’s
<$cdef(27)>comfort level, it’s best to talk to them and <$voicel(1,8)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)>grant
their requests!<$motion(1,652)>

More items will become available at the <$cdef(27)>shop as the
<$cdef(27)>environment level increases!
Use these items to further improve <$cdef(27)>comfort levels and
create new habitats for Pokémon!
Go ahead and check out the <$cdef(27)>Challenges</color> menu!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>What did the <$cdef(27)>PC </color>say? I hope it was something useful...

<$comcan(1)>You can take on <$cdef(27)>challenges to improve the environment
through the <$cdef(27)>PC at the <$cdef(27)>Pokémon Center.
The <$cdef(27)>Life Coins you receive from completing <$cdef(27)>challenges
can be spent at the <$cdef(27)>shop to purchase various items, so
don’t shy away from a good <$cdef(27)>challenge!

You’ve created another Pokémon habitat! New Pokémon
will appear in new habitats!
But it may take some time, so feel free to do other things
while you wait!

<$cdef(27)>Rare Pokémon in particular may take a while to show up,
so just let things take their course. There’s no rush!

The professor gave you good advice—try talking to
<$cdef(27)>Bulbasaur so you can improve their <$cdef(27)>comfort level!
After that, check out the PC!
